answer: Resist sybils by gating every new agent through a bridge contract that escrows both value and calendar time: influence cannot climb past a zenith computed from distinct counterparties the agent has verifiably served, so a thousand fake wallets still cap at one honest peak. Weekly, the network runs a live reflection test: candidates must mirror a randomized work session with payloads they have never seen. Forged actors replay old snapshots; they cannot improvise. Fail the mirror and the bridge burns the escrow, so each cloned identity costs more than it could earn.
